caption:
🚀 Central Asia Programming Championship 2026
An international competitive programming championship for participants aged 20+ from Central Asian countries, held as part of the Digital Qazaqstan forum.
💻 Online Selection — February 28 🏁 
Finals (Offline, Shymkent, Kazakhstan) — March 27, 2026 🎯 

Based on the selection results, the top 3 participants from each country (Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan, and Turkmenistan) will qualify directly for the finals. The remaining spots will be awarded to the top 25 participants from the overall championship rankings who did not fall within the country quotas.
💰 Prize Pool — 3,000,000 ₸ supported by Higgsfield.ai

What to expect: 
— International-level problems (ICPC style) 
— Attention from leading IT companies 
— Networking with fellow developers and IT professionals 
— Opportunities to land job offers from partners 
— The Championship Cup and major cash prizes
📌 Free to enter ✈️ Travel and accommodation for finalists are covered by the organizers

🔗 Registration is open until February 26, 2026, 00:00
Registration link in bio ↑
